faqs.q: How does the AI parse tasks?
faqs.a: Task2Flow uses a fine-tuned language model trained on thousands of real-world workflows. You describe a task or process in plain English and the AI extracts steps, assigns owners, sets dependencies, and builds a structured workflow automatically.

faqs.q: What tools does it integrate with?
faqs.a: Task2Flow connects with 50+ tools including Slack, Notion, Jira, GitHub, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Workspace, Zapier, and more. Our open API lets you connect any custom tool your team uses.

Absolutely. Task2Flow is SOC 2 Type II certified, with end-to-end encryption at rest and in transit. We never train our models on your data. Enterprise plans include SSO, SAML, and dedicated data residency options.

You'll receive an email confirmation immediately. When we launch, you'll get early access before the general public, your pre-order price locked in for life, and a dedicated onboarding session with our team.

faqs.q: Can I import existing workflows from other tools?
faqs.a: Yes. Task2Flow can import from Notion, Asana, Monday.com, Trello, and more. Our AI also helps you clean up and restructure imported workflows so they are actually useful.
Yes — our Starter plan is free forever with up to 5 active workflows and 10 AI parses per month. No credit card required to get started.

faqs.q: How long does it take to set up?
faqs.a: Most teams are running their first workflow within 5 minutes of signing up. There is no complex configuration — just describe your process and go.

faqs.q: Do you offer a team trial?
faqs.a: Yes. Pro and Team plans come with a 14-day free trial, no credit card required. Pre-order customers get an extended 30-day trial at launch.
